{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]}")

# Check channel distribution
df_channel_segment = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f"Channel by customer_segment:\n{df_channel_segment}")"}
